# JavaScript

The browser code for the site. Most of it is the choreography system that animates the homepage; the rest is small helpers.

## What's here

- [choreography/](choreography/README.md) - intro and scroll animation on GSAP. Start here.
- [preloader/](preloader/README.md) - decides when the splash screen leaves
- [effects/](effects/README.md) - gel, halftone and transition effects
- [displays/](displays/README.md) - the ruler overlay and the blockframes wireframe animation
- [layouts/](layouts/README.md) - header scripts for layouts
- [utils/](utils/README.md) - small helpers
- [interstitials/](interstitials/README.md) - text reveal helpers
- [vendor/](vendor/README.md) - vendored third-party scripts

## How it connects

- `npm run build:js` bundles `choreography/AnimationDirector.js` with esbuild into `assets/js/choreography/bundle.js` (git-ignored).
- Eleventy copies the rest of `js/` to `assets/js/`, and page templates load files from there.
- GSAP is copied from `node_modules` to `assets/js/vendor/gsap/`.
